Stats: - 0.2 Weight Options: - Memory of the Fallen (Swear an oath -> to carry the memory of the fallen) - Increases Encumbrance Limit by 25 - Unyielding Sentinel (Swear an oath -> to walk my own path, no matter the cost) - Increases physical damage by 10% - Legacy (Swear an oath -> to build something that will outlast me) - Increases Buff Duration by 25% - Bravery (Swear an oath -> to walk where others fear to tread) - Attacks heavily Burn enemies - The Bond (Memorial for someone -> a fallen friend) - Reduces Stamina usage while blocking by 33%. - Torn Roots (Memorial for someone -> a lost family) - Blocking regenerates 33% of the Damage blocked as Mana. - Mercy (Memorial for someone -> a stranger who deserved better.) - You have 1% chance to instantly kill an enemy if it has less than 20% health.

description: How To Begin: Speak to [Hr'afn](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=461390) and offer to help him out. title: Dead Soldier's Stash
description: How To Begin: Enter the [Gunnvaldr Stronghold](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=459782) and follow the linear corridors to the right. Eventually, you'll find a corpse slumped beneath a banner holding a Kamelot Soldier's Note. Read it to begin the quest. Rewards: - 900 XP - [Buried Chest](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=461878)

title: Left Behind
description: How To Begin: Speak to [Silvius](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=461882) in the [Wretched Hideout](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=459795). Rewards: - 900 XP

title: Ice Weaver Brain for Hr'afn
description: How To Begin: Complete [Frostgrots Mucus for Hrafn](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=461900). Rewards: - 2100 XP - [Frozen Sword](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=461908)

description: How To Begin: Speak to [Ó Cuinn Cinnamonsage](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460069) Reward: - 1600 XP - [Charm of the Faithful Fae](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460071) (if you show him [A Portrait of Ó Cuinn](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460066), or get him to stay in this realm) - [Glass Acorn](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460072) (if you show him [The Taming Fetters](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460065) and tell him to go back to the Fae realm)

title: Something Extremely Fishy
description: Complete [Deep Calleth Upon Deep](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/forlorn-swords?locationIds=460050) and get jiggy with the Morgen to trigger a secret ending. _Transcript:_ The touch of her cold, wet lips douses the flames of your desire. As her claws break the skin of your neck, you begin to realize just how much of a fool you've been. You try to struggle, but her grip is unyielding. Before you can cry out, she pulls you down into the frigid depths. You open your mouth in a silent scream as her teeth sink into your flesh. The darkness that follows feels almost like mercy.

title: Origin Potion
description: Location: [Crypt](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456867) - when you reach the huge room, go down three levels and enter a room on the northern side. Unlock a reinforced chest with a hard-difficulty lock to find it inside.

title: Menhir Statue
description: Speak to [Caradoc](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=458231), ask him for help, then choose to take an artifact. When consumed, receive +5 Max Health permanently.

title: Origin Potion
description: Location: On a corpse south of the Druidic Shrine.

title: Origin Potion
description: Deep inside [Eckhart's Cave](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456466), in a chest next to a bed. Unlock a door with a hard-to-pick lock to get access to it quickly, or progress deeper into the cave and hug the left wall to bypass it.

title: Adamant Aurochs
description: On a crate at the top of the tower. Consume to receive a permanent +3 Max Stamina.

title: Origin Potion
description: Location: Deep inside the [Blood Cave](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456967) - after killing [Mallory](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457065) and following the tunnel beneath the tree, fight through the glowing ruins until you reach some stairs. Take a right, kill the Marrowghast, and unlock a chest with a hard-to-pick lock to find it inside.

title: Giant Feather
description: Reward for completing [(Ir)Rational Hatred](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457263). Consume to receive a permanent +5 to encumbrance limit.

title: Morgaine's Censer
description: [Forgotten Cemetery Crypt](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456421) - When you reach the large room at the back of the crypt, climb the pile of rocks on the right side to find a tunnel. The censer is on a shelf in the tunnel. Consume to receive a permanent +5 Max Mana.

description: Swim beyond the borders of the map to trigger a secret cutscene. _Transcript:_ You swam beyond the breakers, where the sea stretched endless and empty. No boat, no shore - only the abyss below. Then, the water stirred - not with tide or wind, but with something vast and aware. A presence older than gods, lurking where no light has ever reached. You caught a glimpse of shifting scales, of something impossibly vast. Then, the water closed over you, and you were gone.

title: Berg
description: Fishing in the sea. Bring him [Kendall's Skull](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457271) to progress [Best Friends Forever](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=458346)

title: Drest
description: Inside the cave on the beach. Can help with the [Black Tar Prophecies](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456493) and [Age of Excuse](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457266) quests. Becomes a [merchant](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=515876) if he survives the former.

title: Maug
description: Location: Inside the [Small Crypt](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=458056). Jump down the open coffin at the end of the eastern corridor to end up in a cave, where she's a short walk away.

title: Vidar
description: The key to his cage can be found in some crates opposite

title: Caradoc
description: Sitting next to a tree at the top of the hill.

title: Ghost Of Broc Meala
description: Standing next to the fast travel beacon. Speak to him to visit the queen.

title: Shepherd
description: Skeleton sitting on the rocks. Can be spoken to at night. If you've spoken to [Fearghas](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456328), asking the ghost what he's doing here (and saying you know Fearghas from work) triggers a [quest](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=462218).

title: Morris
description: In the basement of [The Mill](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456920), unlocked with the key dropped by [Bald Cait](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456921)

title: Taranis
description: [Mistbearer's Den](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457449) - encountered soon after entering.

title: Rhydderic
description: Inside the museum on the top floor of the [Captain's Quarters](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456943). Speaking to him during [(Ir)Rational Hatred](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457263) unlocks the 'Seagullers Mask' crafting recipe.

title: Yorath
description: At the back of the large chamber deep inside the [Forgotten Cemetery Crypt](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456421). Appears later in the game if you convince him to become a healer.

title: Rumpolt Finnini
description: Inside [Broch Prison](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456501), which can only be opened as part of [The Silk Road](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456315). Gives you the recipe for Sour Herring and Cheese.

title: Eogan
description: In the garden on the roof

title: Muriel
description: A white chicken in [Eogan](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=459105)'s rooftop garden. To speak to it, you'll need to drink [Heber's Elixir](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=459175). A brief conversation with the wise chicken in each region will unlock 'The Oracle's Cluck' trophy / achievement.

title: Sir Lancelot
description: In the [Tomb of Sir Lancelot](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=456292).

title: Tired Guard
description: Inside the [Smuggler's Bay Caves](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457268). If you smoke with him, give him lots of food, and exhaust his dialogue you will unlock the "Blooming Friendship" achievement/trophy.

title: Keeper Fulco
description: Standing on top of the wall.

title: Arnulf
description: Inside the [Smuggler's Bay Caves](https://mapgenie.io/tainted-grail-the-fall-of-avalon/maps/horns-of-the-south?locationIds=457268). Attacks if you refuse his offer.
